put.summary: Add or replace the meeting transcript
put.description:
PUT, not POST: a meeting has exactly one transcript, and sending the same
body twice leaves the same state (idempotent).

post.summary: Queue AI extraction of summary, decisions, and action items
post.description:
Returns immediately. Poll ``GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}`` for the outcome.

Submitting again while a job for this meeting is still queued or running
returns that same job rather than starting a duplicate.

Find transcript passages by meaning, not just matching words
get.description:
Results are ordered by cosine similarity (``score``, higher is closer).

Only meetings the user can access are searched, and only chunks built from
the meeting's current transcript. A meeting becomes searchable once it has
been processed.

Assembled from the stored results, including the user's corrections, so it
always matches what the PDF shows.

409.description: The meeting has not been processed yet (minutes_not_ready).

post.summary: Generate (or reuse) the Minutes of Meeting PDF and get view/download links
post.description:
The PDF is stored in object storage. An identical stored PDF is reused;
if the minutes changed since it was made, a new one is rendered first.

Links are short-lived presigned URLs: ``view_url`` opens in the browser,
``download_url`` saves the file.

409.description: The meeting has not been processed yet (minutes_not_ready).

post.summary: Answer a question from your meetings, with cited sources
post.description:
Searches the transcripts and Minutes of Meeting of the meetings you can
access, and answers **only** from what it finds.

* ``answered``: every statement cites a numbered source, and ``sources``
  lists exactly the cited passages with their meeting.
* ``insufficient_context``: nothing relevant was found, or the model could
  not support an answer from what was found. Nothing is invented.
* ``no_indexed_meetings``: no processed meetings to search yet.

ActionItemUpdateRequest.title: ActionItemUpdateRequest
ActionItemUpdateRequest.description:
Human corrections to an extracted action item. Every field optional.

``deadline`` and ``priority`` may be set to null deliberately (to clear
them); ``task`` and ``status`` may not.

meeting_ids.title: Meeting Ids
meeting_ids.description: Only search these meetings (each must be accessible). Default: all.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Only the sources the answer cites.

retrieved.title: Retrieved
retrieved.description: Passages retrieved and shown to the model.

model.title: Model
model.description: The answering model; null if it was not called.

text.title: Text
text.description: What the model was shown for this source.

ChunkSource.title: ChunkSource
ChunkSource.description:
What a chunk was built from (M8).

``transcript`` passages are exact slices of the transcript (M6). The others
are embedded from the meeting's Minutes of Meeting so questions about
decisions, owners, and open items retrieve the structured answer, not only
the conversation around it.

type.title: Type
type.description: queued, started, transcription_started, transcription_completed, indexing_completed, mom_pdf_generated, mom_pdf_failed, retry_scheduled, lease_expired_requeued, completed, failed

next_attempt_at.title: Next Attempt At
next_attempt_at.description: When a QUEUED job becomes runnable (later than now after a failed attempt).

error.description: For FAILED jobs, the final error. For a QUEUED job that already failed once, the error that caused the retry.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: True when the stored result was current and no LLM call was made.

MeetingStatus.title: MeetingStatus
MeetingStatus.description: Lifecycle of the AI processing pipeline.

MeetingUpdateRequest.title: MeetingUpdateRequest
MeetingUpdateRequest.description:
Partial update - every field optional.

Distinguishing "field absent" from "field set to null" is done with
``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` in the route, so PATCH with an empty
body is a no-op rather than wiping the record.

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.description: The meeting description / agenda, as entered.

next_steps_derived.title: Next Steps Derived
next_steps_derived.description: True when no next steps were stated and they were derived from open action items.

is_stale.title: Is Stale
is_stale.description: The transcript changed after these minutes were extracted.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Known when this request rendered the document.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint
fingerprint.description: Hash of the minutes content the PDF was rendered from.

reused.title: Reused
reused.description: True when an identical stored PDF was reused.

view_url.title: View Url

MomReviewFlag.title: MomReviewFlag

evidence_total.title: Evidence Total
evidence_total.description: Items that carry an evidence quote requirement.

turns.title: Turns
turns.description: Speaking turns counted from the transcript (0 for notes).

share.title: Share
share.description: Share of all spoken words, 0 to 1.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total rows matching the filter, ignoring pagination.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total rows matching the filter, ignoring pagination.

ProcessSubmissionResponse.title: ProcessSubmissionResponse
ProcessSubmissionResponse.description:
Response to POST /meetings/{id}/process.

* 202 with ``job`` set: work was queued (or an identical job was already
  active and is returned instead of starting a duplicate).
* 200 with ``job`` null and ``cached`` true: stored results are already
  current for this transcript, prompt, and model. Nothing was queued.

is_stale.title: Is Stale
is_stale.description: True when the transcript has changed since this summary was generated.

content.title: Content
content.description: Plain-text transcript. Speaker labels such as 'Priya:' improve owner extraction.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: 'transcript' for verbatim speech, 'notes' for meeting notes or a written description. The AI is told which it is reading.

replace_manual_transcript.title: Replace Manual Transcript
replace_manual_transcript.description: A typed/pasted transcript normally takes precedence over a recording. Set true to discard it and transcribe the recording instead.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Checked early for a friendly error; storage enforces the real limit.

UploadUrlResponse.title: UploadUrlResponse
UploadUrlResponse.description:
Everything the browser needs to upload directly to storage.

Send a multipart/form-data POST to ``upload_url`` containing every entry in
``fields`` followed by the file under the name ``file``. Then call
``POST /meetings/{id}/media/complete`` with ``upload_token``.
